doc: Value stored in a key-value map.
name: Lean.DataValue

source.code:
/-- Value stored in a key-value map. -/
inductive DataValue where
  | ofString (v : String)
  | ofBool   (v : Bool)
  | ofName   (v : Name)
  | ofNat    (v : Nat)
  | ofInt    (v : Int)
  | ofSyntax (v : Syntax)
  deriving Inhabited, BEq, Repr
